title: Map, format v0
description: Read by GodGame.Sim.MapData.Load. All lengths in millimetres; x grows east, y north, from the south-west corner. An optional height.bin next to map.json holds int32 little-endian millimetres per cell, rows south to north, each west to east; without it the ground is flat at 0. Heights lie within ±10,000,000 mm; at most 16 million cells.

cellSizeMm.description: Field cell edge; the plan's shared value is 1500

deployment.description: At most one zone per side; minimum inclusive, maximum exclusive

minXMm.description: 0 to the map's size; max above min

minYMm.description: 0 to the map's size; max above min

maxXMm.description: 0 to the map's size; max above min

maxYMm.description: 0 to the map's size; max above min
